route: One full circle at each visited source anchor, then a straight transfer between sleeve contact points; closed source orbit has no duplicated terminal wrap.
assumptions: Sleeve dimensions, 0.5 mm centerline clearance and exactly one full turn are project assumptions. Full circles share one arrival/departure point; tangent transitions, fibre stacking, fibre-fibre interaction and robot collision are not resolved.
quantity_scope: Transfer centerlines plus analytic circle lengths; no waste, start/end tails, boundary reinforcement or hardware mass.
openness_scope: Original span-and-edge projection retained; local wraps and hardware excluded.
